summary: Tightened the typed-source numeric validator for reproduced real-source guard/mutation failures and aligned the native value codec with the emitted Number/BigInt ABI. The profile remains bounded and does not claim general Go range analysis or final four-app bundle success.

confirmed_false_accepts: guarded increment after assigning the variable to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
switch with case x < MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, true reusing the first case guard
raw_failure_lines: unsafe source line was accepted without a numeric-profile diagnostic: state.Mutated++
unsafe source line was accepted without a numeric-profile diagnostic: state.Add += 9007199254740991
unsafe source line was accepted without a numeric-profile diagnostic: state.Subtract -= 9007199254740991
unsafe source line was accepted without a numeric-profile diagnostic: state.SwitchOr++

safe bounded source line was rejected: state.SafeConst++ (integer increment/decrement lacks a safe bound guard)

analyzer_cases: TestLoadAndAnalyzeCompiledFixtures: counter, form, list, and effect entry packages pass LoadSources and Analyze
TestLoadSourcesAndAnalyzeRejectsUnsafeIntegerSource: unsafe probes reject and guarded int64/int8/int32/constant controls pass with source-relative non-empty spans
TestLoadSourcesRejectsMutablePackageGlobalsAndInitFunctions: both entry-package constructs reject with source spans
codec_cases: int and uint Number values at +/-MAX_SAFE boundaries pass; values immediately outside reject
ValidateValue and DecodeValueJSON reject unsafe Number-backed tagged integers
int64 and uint64 BigInt values preserve full Go width, including signed min/max and uint64 max

limitations: The analyzer is a conservative validator for a bounded subset, not a general Go range-analysis proof. It accepts guarded +1/++ and -1/-- plus bounded len(slice-or-array)*2 in make capacity; integer compound assignments and nonconstant integer conversions are rejected.
Entry-package mutable globals and init functions are rejected. Initialization effects in imported dependency packages are not analyzed; the four approved fixtures use trusted dependencies.
Guard facts are local/field-path scoped; arbitrary aliases, interprocedural mutations, and untested control-flow shapes are outside the demonstrated guarantee.
The four-app test proves LoadSources/Analyze admission only; final emitted bundle and browser conformance evidence belong to the other lanes/root.
